name: Name
title: Organizations
description: Organizations on the platform with their owners, members and access state.
forbidden: You are not allowed to view organizations.
empty_description: Create an organization and assign its owner.
empty_filtered_description: Try changing the search or filters.
create_description: Creating an organization also opens its default "Merkez" branch.
detail_description: Organization details, members, status and activity.
columns.name: Organization
fields.name: Organization name
form.section_identity_desc: Name and the short name used in addresses.
form.section_owner_desc: Pick an existing account or invite a new e-mail as owner.
form.slug_hint: Derived from the name (Turkish letters folded); used in /t/slug.
form.slug_change_hint: Changing the slug changes the organization's /t/… address.
form.owner_existing_hint: The account becomes the owner right away.
form.owner_invite_hint: The organization starts without members; the owner joins through the invitation link.
form.owner_email_hint: The invitation is valid for 7 days.
validation.name_too_long: Name can be at most 255 characters.
validation.slug_invalid: The slug may contain lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
validation.access_end_after_start: The end must be after the start.
status_confirm.suspend_description: Every member loses access immediately. No data is deleted.
status_confirm.activate_description: Members can access the organization again within its access window.
toast.created_invited: Organization created; owner invitation sent to {{email}}.
status_tab.active_hint: The organization is active; members can sign in within the access window.
status_tab.suspended_hint: The organization is suspended; members cannot open the panel.
managed.domains_title: Domains are managed in the organization panel
managed.domains_body: The organization adds and verifies its own domains under Settings → Branded site → Domains. Every organization's domains, with their DNS and certificate status, are in the platform domain list.
managed.integrations_title: Connections are managed in the organization panel
managed.integrations_body: The organization's payment, e-invoice, KABİS and sales channel connections are managed under Settings → Integrations in its panel. Connection tests and failed jobs are tracked on the platform health page.
members.add_description: The user joins with the selected roles and branch access.
members.user_hint: Search by e-mail or name. Invite new people instead.
members.empty_description: Add an existing user or send an invitation.
form.plan_hint: Complete enables every feature; Management includes the panel only.
plan.features_description: Each feature comes from the plan and can be switched on or off for this company. Customer contract, payment and document links work on every plan.
plan.plan_hint: Changing the plan keeps past rental and finance records; features that turn off only stop being served.
plan.records_hint: Domains, keys, channel accounts and past records are never deleted.
plan.forbidden: You are not allowed to view organization plans.
plan.load_failed: The plan could not be loaded.
plan.validation.period_end_after_start: The period end must be after its start.
